challenge.title: A Morning of Errands
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 12 lines in Lebanese in which you withdraw cash at the bank, ask where the post office is and what it costs to send a parcel, and top up your phone balance. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 19.
required_elements: A request at the bank such as بدّي إسحب شوية كاش.
A question about where something is with وين, for example the post office.
A question about a price with قدّيش, for example the shipping.
A request to top up the phone balance with بدّي عبّي رصيد.
A polite word such as من فضلك or مرسي.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير. بدّي إسحب شوية كاش، من فضلك.
dialogue.transliteration: Sabaa7 el-khayr. baddi es7ab shwayyet kaash, min faDlak.
dialogue.english: Good morning. I want to withdraw some cash, please.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.english: Good morning. How much do you want?

dialogue.arabic: ميّة دولار. وين مكتب البريد من هون؟
dialogue.transliteration: miyyet dolaar. wein maktab el-bareed min hon?
dialogue.english: A hundred dollars. Where is the post office from here?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.arabic: تفضّل. مكتب البريد بآخر الشارع، حدّ محلّ التلفونات.

dialogue.english: Here you are. The post office is at the end of the street, next to the phone shop.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
